sentiment.rationale: Forward guidance for Q3 2025 revenue is about $8.7B, up 28% year over year, but this is not a raise relative to prior guidance — it explicitly excludes any MI308 China revenue while export licenses remain under review, capping upside. The Data Center segment, critical to the AI thesis, grew only 14%, a deceleration that signals a structural headwind. Management also flagged gross margin pressure from the MI350 ramp and unfavorable product mix in Embedded, reinforcing a cautious forward outlook. The score is -0.50 because guidance is effectively held flat with explicit downside risks (China export uncertainty, margin pressure) and the core AI growth engine slowed.
